text: 1.3 Sorry, but I've forgotten your name. Anna. Oh yeah, sorry, hi. So, what did you do in the first half of the class? I don't know. I missed it as well. Oh dear. Why was that? Well, I was late getting up, and then I rushed out of the house to get the train, but when I got to the station, I realised I'd forgotten my book. So I went back home to get it, and then I realised I didn't have my keys either. I rang the bell, but my flatmate was sleeping so he didn't answer. I was banging on the door and shouting, but nothing. He must be a really heavy sleeper. It's not that really. He works nights, so he doesn't get home till five o'clock in the morning. Oh right. So did you get in the house? No. In the end I stopped trying, but by then I'd missed my train to get here, and I had to wait another twenty minutes before the next one came. Oh right, where about are you living? Moncada. It's only about 20 minutes by train from here, but the trains only run every 30 minutes. So anyway, what about you? What's your excuse? Sorry? What's your excuse for being late? Oh right, sorry. Well, I'm looking for a flat to rent, and I was phoning round a few places this morning before class. Right, so did you have any luck? Not really. I'm going to see one later near the centre of town, but it's quite expensive. Mmm. Actually, Frank, the German guy in class, was telling me that you're looking for another person to share your flat. Yeah, well, we've got a spare room, and it'd be good to pay less rent. So, how much would it be? I guess about 40 euros a week. Really? That's really cheap. So, what's the room like? It's alright. It's quite big. The only problem is, it's an internal room. I mean, it doesn't have any windows to the outside, so there's no natural light. Oh, right. And how many people live there? Oh, just the two of us. Me and this Spanish guy, Pedro.
